data.name: Audio-Technica AT-LP120
data.description: The centerpiece of the setup. Direct drive, so it gets up to speed instantly and holds it — and it still wears the AT95E it shipped with, because nothing about it needed fixing.

parts.name: Audio-Technica AT95E
parts.description: The cartridge the LP120 arrived with, and still the one on the arm. An elliptical stylus tracks more of the groove wall than the conical ones it replaced, which is most of why records here sound like records.

data.name: Yamaha A-S301
data.description: Powers everything and does all the switching. Tone controls when a record needs them, Pure Direct when it doesn't, and a built-in DAC so the digital sources land here too.

data.name: Telefunken HC650
data.description: There's something magical about tape. Making mixtapes is still one of my favourite things, and this deck is the reason the habit never died.

data.name: LG DVD Player
data.description: A DVD player from around 2005 that has never once played a DVD here — it lives in the rack purely as a CD transport. Drop a disc in, press play, done.

data.name: Polk ES20
data.description: Bookshelf pair on stands, doing far more than their size suggests. Punchy lows from the rear port and highs that stay clean when the volume goes up.
